AlternateTargets: the Buddha raises a flower and Kashyapa smiles
Senses.Explanation: The flower-sermon scene: Shakyamuni Buddha holds up a flower before the Vulture Peak assembly, the assembly is at a loss, and Kashyapa smiles (世尊在靈山會上拈華顧眾，百萬人天皆悉罔措，唯迦葉尊者破顏微笑). The compact phrase joins two different actors' gestures; it does not say that one person both holds the flower and smiles. The recorded Buddha then entrusts Kashyapa with the treasury of the true teaching eye and a transmission outside teachings. Later masters challenge the scene. Yuelin Zongshan assigns thirty blows at the moment of the flower and smile. Dongshan Shouchu says people know the compact phrase but do not know the World-Honored One. Yulin Tongxiu calls it a single transmission and says it has made clear-eyed people laugh. Zhongfeng Mingben says that if the great affair were exhausted by such gestures, holding up the flower and smiling and cutting off an arm to settle the mind would be mere plays. Tianran Hanshi calls only this purport real and all other verbal teachings false, then immediately warns against making it a fixed reality. Zen defines the invoked Buddha and Kashyapa through this public scene, entrustment, and later examinations rather than through general hagiography.
Senses.Note: The flower graphs (華) and (花) are graphic variants, not senses. The compact headword names the whole recorded scene as well as its two gestures. Four exact witnesses across four texts meet the floor; four scene/component anchors are supporting evidence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊在靈山會上拈華顧眾，百萬人天皆悉罔措，唯迦葉尊者破顏微笑。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Jizong Che (季總徹禪師語錄), where Jizong Che raises the full flower-sermon scene; it lacks the compact headword and supports the family.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊云：『吾以正法眼藏、涅槃玅心、實相無相微玅法門，不立文字，教外別傳，付囑摩訶迦葉。』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Jizong Che (季總徹禪師語錄), quoting Shakyamuni Buddha's entrustment to Kashyapa; this continuation lacks the headword and supports the scene family.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊拈華，迦葉微笑。正當恁麼時，好與三十棒。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jiatai Universal Lamp Record (嘉泰普燈錄), spoken by Yuelin Zongshan; the separated flower-and-smile wording supports the family but not exact depth.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊拈華。迦葉微笑時。人祇知拈華微笑。要且不識世尊。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), in Dongshan Shouchu's section; Dongshan Shouchu says people know the exact compact scene but not the World-Honored One.

Occurrences.Kwic: 至於拈華微笑謂之單傳正法眼藏也引他明眼人至今好笑
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of National Teacher Puji Yulin (普濟玉琳國師語錄), spoken by Yulin Tongxiu; he names the exact phrase a single transmission and records continuing laughter.

Occurrences.Kwic: 拈華微笑斷臂安心只成戱劇耳。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Zhongfeng of Tianmu (天目中峰廣錄), spoken by Zhongfeng Mingben; he says the exact phrase and cutting off an arm would be mere plays if treated as exhausting the great affair.

Occurrences.Kwic: 惟此拈華微笑之旨得名為實，其餘一切言教皆名為虛。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Lushan Tianran (廬山天然禪師語錄), spoken by Tianran Hanshi; he contrasts the purport of the exact phrase with all other verbal teachings.

Occurrences.Kwic: 拈花微笑，猶乖量外之機；斷臂安心，何異捉月之見？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Linked Lamps Compendium (聯燈會要), in Puxian Yuansu's section; Puxian directly criticizes the common-flower graph variant as still missing the measure-transcending pivot. It anchors the variant family and does not count toward the traditional-flower headword floor.
